title: Spain - 2026.08.04
notes: A cluster of corruption investigations targeting people close to Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez, combined with a deepening national argument over migration policy, has pushed Spanish politics into one of its most turbulent periods in recent memory. While Sánchez himself has not been formally implicated in any of the probes, the political damage is accumulating around his inner circle. The dual pressure is testing institutional trust and reshaping the country's political landscape ahead of potential electoral reckoning.
